csv_scope_of_work: The Housing Authority of the City of Shreveport ("HACS") invites qualified firms to submit proposals to provide modernization, development consulting, architectural, engineering, construction administration, and related professional services on an as - needed basis. The selected firm(s) will support HACS in the planning, design, funding, rehabilitation, modernization, redevelopment, demolition, and construction of public housing and affordable housing developments. Services may support HUD Capital Fund projects, development initiatives, mixed-finance transactions, RAD conversions, and other housing authority programs.
